newsitem.title: FRANCE: Volvo Cars delays sales-start of C70.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Cars delays sales-start of C70.

text.p: Volvo Cars will start selling the new coupe-model C70 late in March 1997, Volvo Cars CEO Tuve Johannesson told Reuters in an interview on Monday.
"We will start selling the C70 in late March. That will give us time to be very sure that we bring out a top quality car," Johannesson said.

Earlier plans had set January as the sales-start for the new model, but Johannesson conceded the fate of the S40/V40-model has made Volvo's cautious. Volvo was forced to make adjustments on the S40/V40 after its introduction, which subsequently led to a big order backlog.

"You might say that, psychologically, we have been influenced by what happened to the S40/V40. Maybe we were a bit too optimistic, but now we feel we want to be absolutely sure that we put a top quality product on the market," Johannesson said.
